by_lifecycle.lead: A requirement can belong to several life-cycle phases and is then counted in each of them. The phases are taken from the controlled vocabulary.
by_theme.lead: Every requirement belongs to exactly one theme cluster of the controlled vocabulary.
classification.caption: Decision areas of the regulatory classification
classification.lead: The classification follows the catalogued decision rules only. Open review points and missing inputs are never presented as a decision.
classification.missing_input: Incomplete input: rule {rule} requires “{key}” ({question}). The path was stopped without assumption.
classification.rules_caption: Applied decision rules with source references
col.question: Question
col.title: Title
disclaimer.p1: This report is the result of a rule-based demonstrator. It does not replace legal advice, certification or a conformity assessment by an authority or a notified body.
disclaimer.p2: The report covers only the versioned catalogs and theme clusters listed in section 2. Requirements outside this scope are not assessed; no statement is made about the completeness of all requirements applicable to the product.
disclaimer.p3: Fulfilment statuses, justifications and evidence references are statements of the user. RegScoutX does not check document contents; an existing evidence reference does not prove that a requirement is fulfilled.
empty.detailed_requirements: No requirement is applicable or unresolved.
empty.measures: No measures are assigned to applicable requirements.
empty.review_decisions: No open review points from decision rules.
gap_summary.caption: Gap status of all requirements
gap_summary.distribution_caption: Distribution of applicable requirements by gap status
gap_summary.lead: The gap status combines applicability with the user's structured fulfilment assessment. A missing assessment or a missing evidence reference is never counted as “not fulfilled”.
gap_summary.note: A gap exists for partial or missing fulfilment and for claimed fulfilment without an evidence reference. Requirements that are not applicable or unresolved are not included in the share.
identification.note: The assessment is uniquely identified by identifier, revision and domain fingerprint. Generation time and language are metadata; the content hash changes only with the domain content, the language or the schema version.
measures.caption: Planned measures for applicable requirements
measures.lead: Measures and planned evidence types are taken from the versioned measure catalog. They describe which kind of evidence is expected, not whether evidence exists.
measures.mapping_review: For {count} applicable requirements no measure is assigned (assignment open); this is listed as an open item and not assumed.
measures.separation_note: The planned evidence type from the measure catalog, the evidence references recorded by the user and the project evidence of the demonstrator are kept separate; only the first two appear in this report.
method.p1: RegScoutX is rule-based and deterministic; no generative AI is used. Identical inputs, assessments and catalog versions yield the same result and the same domain fingerprint.
method.p2: Derivation chain per requirement: inputs, evaluated conditions, decision rules and decision areas, applicability, requirement, gap status, planned measure and evidence reference. Section 9 shows the chain for every applicable and unresolved requirement.
method.p3: Applicability follows only the versioned applicability mapping and the decision results; requirement texts are not evaluated. Cases that cannot be decided remain unresolved and are never presented as applicable or not applicable.
method.p4: The report is created from the stored revision without recomputing decisions, applicability or gap status. If the catalog versions match, the stored state is checked against a re-evaluation before the report is generated.
method.p5: Source references are locators of the versioned source register. Primary law and guidance are shown separately.
open_points.lead: Open items comprise review points from decision rules, incomplete inputs, unresolved applicability, requirements not yet assessed, earlier assessments to be confirmed, missing evidence references and open measure assignments.
open_points.review_caption: Open review points from decision rules
profile.caption: Recorded product inputs
profile.lead: The product profile comprises {count} controlled inputs. Free text is not a decision input.
